projects.subject: Odio, Award Winning Music Creation app
projects.preview: A Web Platform for converting simple Humming or Beat-Boxing to Instrumental Music, recognized at Microsoft Code.Fun.Do and Imagine Cup.
projects.content: Odio is a web platform that converts simple humming or beat-boxing to instrumental music. The application uses a Keras LSTM RNN Beat Classifier with MFCC Features and the Yin PDA Algorithm for pitch detection, with Keras.js enabling real-time prediction in the browser. The project was awarded 2nd Runner Up at Microsoft Code.Fun.Do in 2017 and was a National Qualifier for the Microsoft Imagine Cup.

projects.subject: AllMeds, Mitigating Counterfeit Medicines
projects.preview: A platform using Solidity smart-contracts to capture medicine supply chain data and allow end-users to validate their medicine.
projects.content: AllMeds is a project designed to mitigate counterfeit medicines by leveraging blockchain technology. I created Solidity smart-contracts to capture data across the medicine supply chain. This data is made accessible to end-users through a web interface, where they can validate their medicine using its unique registration ID.
